senses.gloss:
शठ् I. €1 P. (शठति)
—1 To deceive, cheat, defraud.
—2 To hurt, kill.
—3 To suffer pain. ━II. €10 P. (शाठयति)
—1 To finish.
—2 To leave unfinished.
—3 To go, move.
—4 To be idle or lazy (शठयति).
—5 To deceive, cheat.
—6 To speak ill of.
—7 To speak well or elegantly.

सठ् €10 U. (साठयति-ते)
—1 To finish, complete.
—2 To leave unfinished.
—3 To go, move.
—4 To adorn, decorate.

शठ a. [शठ्-अच्]
—1 Crafty, deceitful, fraudulent, dishonest, perfidious.
—2 Wicked, depraved.

शठ + .{@-ठः@}
—1 A rogue, cheat, knave, swindler; Ms. 4. 30; Bg. 18. 28.
—2 A false or deceitful lover (who pretends to love one woman while his
 heart is fixed on another); ध्रुवमस्मि शठः शुचिस्मिते विदितः कैतववत्सलस्तव
 R. 8. 49, 19. 31; शठ इति मयि तावदस्तु ते परिचयवत्यवधीरणा प्रिये
 M. 3. 19; (the S. D. thus defines a शठः-शठोऽयमेकत्र बद्धभावो
 यः । दर्शितबहिरनुरागो विप्रियमन्यत्र गूढमाचरति ॥ 74).
—3 A fool, blockhead.
—4 A mediator, arbitrator.
—5 The Dhattūra plant.
—6 An idler, a lazy fellow.
शठ + -उदर्क a. deceitful in the end.

शाठ्यम् [शठस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
——(a) Dishonesty, perfidy, guile; trickery, fraud, villainy; आजन्मनः
 शाठ्यमशिक्षितो यः Ś. 5. 25; दाक्षिण्यं स्वजने दया परजने शाठ्यं
 सदा दुर्जने Bh. 2. 22.
——(b) Art, skill, cunning; देव्या निह्नोतुमिच्छेरिति सुरसरितं शाठ्यमव्याद्विभोर्वः Mu. 1. 1.
